createTable.remarks: One of a Retailer's e-shops, serving one country with its own assortment and prices

column.name: id
column.remarks: The primary key, a short stable code chosen by us, identical in the Ingestion, e.g. 'rimi-lt'

column.name: retailer_id
column.remarks: The Retailer owning this Catalogue

column.name: country
column.remarks: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country served, e.g. 'LT'

column.name: primary_language
column.remarks: ISO 639-1 code of the language every listed product is named in, e.g. 'lt'

column.name: active
column.remarks: Whether assessments may be made in this Catalogue

createTable.remarks: A physical product as the Retailer identifies it, the same in every Catalogue of the Retailer

column.name: id
column.remarks: The primary key, assigned by HowiBuy; the Ingestion assigns its own

column.name: retailer_id
column.remarks: The Retailer of the product; part of the external key

column.name: product_key
column.remarks: The Retailer's own id of the product; part of the external key

column.name: characteristics
column.remarks: The language-neutral characteristics of the product, a JSON object of strings

column.name: tags
column.remarks: The language-neutral tags of the product

column.name: input_hash
column.remarks: The classification input hash computed by the Ingestion over the names, characteristics and tags

column.name: change_sequence
column.remarks: The sequence of the Product Change of the Ingestion that brought the current state

createTable.remarks: The name of a Retailer Product in one language

column.name: retailer_product_id
column.remarks: The product this name belongs to; part of the primary key

column.name: lang
column.remarks: ISO 639-1 language code, e.g. 'en', 'el'; part of the primary key

column.name: name
column.remarks: The name

createTable.remarks: A Retailer Product on sale in one Catalogue, at that Catalogue's price

column.name: retailer_product_id
column.remarks: The product on sale; part of the primary key

column.name: catalogue_id
column.remarks: The Catalogue it is on sale in; part of the primary key

column.name: price
column.remarks: The price in the Catalogue

column.name: currency
column.remarks: ISO 4217 code of the currency of the price, e.g. 'EUR'

column.name: active
column.remarks: Whether the Listing is in its Catalogue's latest Feeds; an inactive one is never offered as an Alternative

createTable.remarks: How far the Product Changes of an Ingestion have been applied

column.name: source
column.remarks: The primary key, the Ingestion the changes come from

column.name: last_sequence
column.remarks: The change sequence of the Ingestion up to which the changes have been applied, 0 for none
